# Maciej Koch

> Personal site of Maciej Koch, a software engineer based near Cieszyn, Poland. Single page with three sections: Me, Exp (work and education) and Stack (technologies), in English at / and in Polish at /pl. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript and three.js; the text content is prerendered into the HTML.

Work: Fullstack Developer at Software Mind (2022–now), Frontend Developer at Ultimate Systems (2021).
Education: Computer Science MSc, University of Silesia (2022–2023); Computer Science BSc (Eng.), AGH University of Science and Technology (2018–2022).
Stack: React, TypeScript, Redux, MUI, Sass, Node.js, Express, Python, Django, SQL, three.js, React Three Fiber, GLSL, Git, Figma.
